versions.changelog:
Initial release of the knowledge management skill.

- Capture, summarize, and organize knowledge from URLs, YouTube videos, documents, and files.
- Proactively recall stored knowledge when relevant to user queries.
- Flexible directory structure with category-based organization and unsorted entries.
- Automatic summary generation and category indexing for persistent agent memory.
- Git integration for version control of the knowledge base.
- Customizable knowledge base location, with persistent path and lightweight structural index.
